settings.html: <style>@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Lato:wght@300;400;700&display=swap'); .blog-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 40px; } @media (max-width: 1024px) { .blog-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 32px; } } @media (max-width: 768px) { .blog-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; } } .b-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-decoration: none !important; height: 100%; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .b-img-wrap { aspect-ratio: 4/3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); } .b-img-wrap img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.7s ease; } .b-card:hover .b-img-wrap img { transform: scale(1.05); } .b-cat { font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #688F9D; margin-bottom: 12px; display: block; text-decoration: none !important; } .b-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif !important; font-size: 24px !important; line-height: 1.3 !important; color: #0E1B30; margin: 0 0 12px; transition: color 0.3s ease; text-decoration: none !important; } .b-card:hover .b-title { color: #688F9D; } .b-desc { font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; color: rgba(14, 27, 48, 0.6); line-height: 1.625; margin: 0 0 16px; flex-grow: 1; text-decoration: none !important; } .b-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(14, 27, 48, 0.4); } .b-meta i { font-size: 12px; } .blog-grid * { text-decoration: none !important; }</style>
